ir.name: builder_gap_topk_pairs_003
ir.intuition: Select preference pairs only when the objective gap is meaningfully positive (to reduce noisy ties/near-ties), then cap pairs per instance and globally using deterministic top-k by gap magnitude.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    # lower objective is better; prefer i over j when objective[i] + gap_thr < objective[j]
    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 1e-3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    max_pairs_per_instance = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 64))

    # pairwise gap matrix: gap[b,i,j] = objective[b,j] - objective[b,i]
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]
    valid = gap > gap_thr

    # Select strongest gaps first (deterministic) and cap per instance.
    B, T = objective.shape
    flat_gap = gap.view(B, -1)
    flat_valid = valid.view(B, -1)
    # Exclude invalid and diagonal by setting to -inf
    scores = torch.where(flat_valid, flat_gap, torch.full_like(flat_gap, float('-inf')))
    k_per = min(max_pairs_per_instance, T * T)
    top_scores, top_idx = torch.topk(scores, k=k_per, dim=1)
    keep = top_scores > float('-inf')

    # Decode (i,j) from flattened index
    winner_idx = (top_idx // T).masked_select(keep)
    loser_idx = (top_idx % T).masked_select(keep)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device)[:, None].expand(B, k_per).masked_select(keep)

    # Global cap by strongest gaps
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        sel_scores = top_scores.masked_select(keep)
        _, order = torch.topk(sel_scores, k=max_pairs, dim=0)
        b_idx = b_idx[order]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[order]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[order]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'gap_topk_pairs',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': max_pairs_per_instance,
        },
    )
